name: table-360-only-flow
title: Simplify tables to a 360-only visual flow
description: Upgrade the add-table modal and remove per-table 3D/AR placement so each table exposes only photo/360 viewing.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Completed the active 360-only product flow. TableManagement no longer imports, renders or calls the per-table model/AR simulator; table cards expose only 360 viewing/setup, and the add-table form contains operational fields only. Shared manager/public floor queries no longer request visualConfig. The table mutation boundary strips legacy model payloads and rejects the old AR signature that paired visualConfig with a derived position while preserving ordinary moveTable coordinates. The backend legacy field remains for historic-record compatibility. No CI workflow, component tests, GraphQL checks, production build, 390x844/430x932 viewport checks or physical-phone panorama validation were available through the GitHub connector.
